description:
Post this reconciled bank entry into the GL (clean-bank settlement).

Matched → Dr Bank / Cr AR; unmatched → Dr Bank / Cr Suspense; a previously-suspensed
entry now fully matched → Dr Suspense / Cr AR. Idempotent, and a no-op (``skipped``) when
the GL chart is not configured for native settlement. The matcher still owns
``reconciliation_status``. See doc/architecture.md §"Posting general ledger".

**A Skonto the person confirms (ZEN-526).** ``cash_discounts`` names, per open item this
movement pays, the cash discount the counterparty took: the item is released by the cash
plus that, the discount booked on the direction's Skonto account with its VAT taken back,
exactly as ``POST …/gl/payments`` books ``cash_discount_amount``. 422 when no Skonto account
is configured, when an item is not one this settle pays, when cash + discount exceeds
what is open or the VAT it takes back does not fit it, and when the settle books no
payment for the item at all (the movement already settled it, a blocker): the transaction
rolls back, so nothing is booked. Never proposed or applied without a person naming it.

anyOf.description:
Optional body of ``POST /bank-entries/{id}/settle``. Empty (or no body) is the ordinary
settle; nothing is ever discounted unless a person names it here.

items.description:
A Skonto the person confirms on a short match (ZEN-526, decision D8): the counterparty
took ``amount`` (the open item's own currency) as a cash discount, so the item is released
by the movement's cash plus this, the discount booked on the direction's Skonto account
with its recognised VAT taken back — the payment door's leg, never a write-off.

name: settle_entry
